Modules.StandardReadOnly: Built-in standard asset (read-only). Clone it into a project library to edit its graph.
Modules.PositionStep.Name: Euler Position Step
Modules.PositionStep.Description: Pure update-step kernel: positionNext = positionPrevious + velocity * deltaTime. The caller must pass and retain particle state.
Modules.VelocityStep.Name: Euler Velocity Step
Modules.VelocityStep.Description: Pure update-step kernel: velocityNext = velocityPrevious + acceleration * deltaTime. The caller must pass and retain particle state.
Modules.InitialVelocity.Name: Initial Velocity from Direction and Speed
Modules.InitialVelocity.Description: Normalizes a caller-supplied direction and scales it by speed. No random direction or hidden spawn state is introduced.
Modules.EffectCurve.Name: Effect-Time F-Curve
Modules.EffectCurve.Description: Exposes a scalar F-Curve sampled by the runtime's effect-time clock. Curve key times are seconds; they are not normalized particle age.
Modules.WorldLookAt.Name: World Look At
Modules.WorldLookAt.Description: Builds a world-facing transform toward an explicit target point. Defaults use mesh +X forward and +Z up. Pass a camera position when needed; no engine camera singleton is read. Degenerate frames return a zero matrix and Valid = 0.
Modules.SphericalBillboard.Name: Spherical Billboard
Modules.SphericalBillboard.Description: Builds a full camera-facing transform from explicit world Position and Target inputs. Pass the camera position as Target; no hidden camera lookup or per-frame state is used.
Modules.TreeBillboard.Name: Tree Billboard
Modules.TreeBillboard.Description: Builds an axial billboard by projecting the explicit target direction onto the plane perpendicular to World Up, preserving that axis. Defaults use mesh +X forward and +Z up.
Modules.Units.PositionStep: Position units are caller-defined; velocity is position-units/second; delta time is seconds.
Modules.Units.VelocityStep: Velocity is position-units/second; acceleration is position-units/second²; delta time is seconds.
Modules.Units.InitialVelocity: Direction is dimensionless; speed and output velocity use caller-defined position-units/second.
Modules.Units.EffectCurve: F-Curve key time and runtime effect time are seconds; output units are caller-defined.
Modules.Units.Billboard: Position and Target are world positions in the caller's coordinate units; Pivot is mesh-local. World Up and local axes are dimensionless directions; Scale is dimensionless. Tolerance is the caller-selected degeneracy threshold. World Matrix maps mesh-local coordinates into world space.
Modules.Inputs.PositionStep: Previous Position (Vector3), Velocity (Vector3), Delta Time (Float seconds).
Modules.Inputs.VelocityStep: Previous Velocity (Vector3), Acceleration (Vector3), Delta Time (Float seconds).
Modules.Inputs.EffectCurve: No graph input. Samples the public F-Curve using runtime effect time.
Modules.Inputs.Billboard: Position, Target, World Up, Local Forward, Local Up, Scale, Pivot, and Tolerance. Target is explicit (use camera position for a camera-facing effect); no engine camera singleton is read.
Modules.Outputs.Billboard: World Matrix (Matrix) and Valid (Float: 1 for a valid orientation, 0 for a degenerate frame; invalid matrix is zero).
Modules.State.CallerOwned: Stateless math only. Caller owns previous values, invocation cadence, and integration order.
Modules.State.Stateless: Stateless. No hidden particle state, scheduler, or random seed.
Modules.Parameter.TimeScaleDescription: Multiplies the supplied delta time. This does not create or retain simulation state.
Modules.Parameter.CurveDescription: Authored in seconds and sampled against effect time, not particle normalized age.
Modules.Billboard.Parameter.Position.Des: World-space anchor for the mesh. Position and Target must use the same coordinate system.
Modules.Billboard.Parameter.Target.Name: Target / Camera Position
Modules.Billboard.Parameter.Target.Descr: Explicit world point the mesh faces. Supply the camera position for camera-facing output; no global camera is queried.
Modules.Billboard.Parameter.WorldUp.Name: World Up
Modules.Billboard.Parameter.WorldUp.Desc: Reference up direction. Tree Billboard preserves this axis.
Modules.Billboard.Parameter.LocalForward: Mesh-local forward axis that will face Target. Default is +X.
Modules.Billboard.Parameter.LocalUp.Name: Mesh Up Axis
Modules.Billboard.Parameter.LocalUp.Desc: Mesh-local up axis; keep it perpendicular to Local Forward. Default is +Z.
Modules.Billboard.Parameter.Scale.Name: Mesh Scale
Modules.Billboard.Parameter.Scale.Descri: Nonuniform mesh-local scale. Negative components deliberately flip the corresponding facing axis.
Modules.Billboard.Parameter.Pivot.Name: Mesh Pivot
Modules.Billboard.Parameter.Pivot.Descri: Mesh-local point mapped onto World Position.
Modules.Billboard.Parameter.Tolerance.De: Positive minimum distance/axis threshold, clamped to at least 1e-12. Invalid orientation returns a zero matrix.
Modules.Backend.GenericPortable: Generic graph bytecode / portable C++ Core. Host rendering is separate.
Modules.Backend.GenericCurve: Portable C++ Core and converter curve bytecode; Unity / Unreal rendering integration is not certified by this module.
